dz: 乌尔班教宗二世的第一个统领开始于梅尔菲,有70名主教和12名阿比特人出席. 该会发布多起关于教会法的法令并处理与教会希腊部分的关系.
de: The first synod of pope Urban II starts in Melfi, with seventy bishops and twelve abbots in attendance. The synod issues several decrees about church law and deals with the relation with the Greek part of the Church.
